expressions.example: Doctor, we're losing him! His heart rate is dropping.
expressions.translation: 선생님, 그를 잃고 있어요! 심박수가 떨어지고 있습니다.

expressions.example: Code blue in room 302, all available staff respond.
expressions.translation: 302호실 심정지 응급상황, 가능한 모든 인력은 대응 바랍니다.
expressions.situation: 심정지 등 응급 상황을 알릴 때

expressions.example: The monitor flatlined right after surgery began.
After thirty minutes of CPR, the doctor called it.
Time of death, 3:42 PM.
Check his vitals every fifteen minutes.
The patient is stable for now.
She's in critical condition after the accident.
Prep him for surgery immediately.
Dr. Kim will scrub in for the operation.
expressions.translation: 김 선생님이 수술에 참여하기 위해 준비할 거예요.

expressions.example: Scalpel, please.
The wound needs about ten sutures.
expressions.translation: 그 상처는 봉합사 열 개 정도가 필요해요.

expressions.example: The nurse stitched up the cut on his arm.
expressions.translation: 간호사는 그의 팔에 난 상처를 꿰맸어요.

expressions.example: Start an IV drip right away.
We need to administer medication to lower his fever.
expressions.translation: 그의 열을 낮추기 위해 약물을 투여해야 해요.

expressions.example: Double-check the dosage before giving it to the patient.
expressions.translation: 환자에게 주기 전에 투여량을 다시 확인하세요.

expressions.example: He's having an allergic reaction to the medication.
expressions.translation: 그는 그 약물에 알레르기 반응을 보이고 있어요.

expressions.example: The patient is under general anesthesia.
We're going to put you under for the procedure.
The patient is being taken to the operating room now.
He was rushed to the ER after the fall.
expressions.translation: 그는 넘어진 후 응급실로 급히 이송됐어요.

expressions.example: The nurse conducted triage as patients arrived.
expressions.translation: 간호사는 환자들이 도착하는 대로 중증도를 분류했어요.

expressions.example: This is a level one trauma case.
expressions.translation: 이건 최고 등급의 외상 환자 사례입니다.

expressions.example: We have a patient with a gunshot wound to the chest.
Scans show signs of internal bleeding.
He suffered a cardiac arrest in the waiting room.
The team worked hard to resuscitate the patient.
expressions.translation: 팀은 환자를 소생시키기 위해 열심히 노력했어요.

expressions.example: Start CPR immediately!
Bring the defibrillator, now!
Clear! Charging to 200.
I've got a pulse, weak but there.
No pulse, starting compressions.
His blood pressure is dropping fast.
Get a crash cart in here, stat!
I need those results stat.
Dr. Lee is on call tonight.
She's been working a double shift since morning.
expressions.translation: 그녀는 아침부터 두 배 근무를 하고 있어요.

expressions.example: The attending physician reviewed her chart.
The residents rotate through different departments.
As an intern, she barely slept during her first week.
expressions.translation: 인턴으로서 그녀는 첫 주에 거의 잠을 못 잤어요.

expressions.example: The chief of surgery approved the risky procedure.
expressions.translation: 외과 과장은 그 위험한 시술을 승인했어요.

expressions.example: He's brilliant, but his bedside manner needs work.
expressions.translation: 그는 뛰어난 실력자지만 환자를 대하는 태도는 개선이 필요해요.

expressions.example: I'd like to get a second opinion before the surgery.
expressions.translation: 수술 전에 다른 의사의 소견을 듣고 싶어요.

expressions.example: The diagnosis came back as early-stage cancer.
The clinic misdiagnosed his condition twice.
expressions.translation: 그 병원은 그의 상태를 두 번이나 오진했어요.

expressions.example: We need to run some tests to be sure.
expressions.translation: 확실히 하기 위해 몇 가지 검사를 진행해야 해요.

expressions.example: The biopsy results should be back tomorrow.
Unfortunately, the tumor is malignant.
Good news, the growth is benign.
Her cancer has been in remission for two years.
The doctor gave him a hopeful prognosis.
He's been managing a chronic condition for years.
She was diagnosed with a terminal illness.
The family chose palliative care for their father.
expressions.translation: 가족은 아버지를 위해 완화 치료를 선택했어요.

expressions.example: The patient has a do not resuscitate order.
expressions.translation: 그 환자는 소생술 거부 의사를 밝힌 상태예요.

expressions.example: We need to notify his next of kin.
expressions.translation: 그의 가장 가까운 친족에게 알려야 해요.

expressions.example: We need her informed consent before the operation.
expressions.translation: 수술 전 그녀의 충분한 설명에 근거한 동의가 필요해요.

expressions.example: The family is suing the hospital for malpractice.
expressions.translation: 가족은 병원을 상대로 의료 과실 소송을 제기했어요.

expressions.example: He's finally on the mend after the surgery.
expressions.translation: 그는 수술 후 드디어 회복 중이에요.

expressions.example: It was touch and go for the first few hours.
expressions.translation: 처음 몇 시간 동안은 상황이 매우 위태로웠어요.

expressions.example: She's been on life support since the accident.
expressions.translation: 그녀는 사고 이후 계속 생명유지장치를 달고 있어요.

expressions.example: The family had to decide whether to pull the plug.
He's flatlining, get the crash cart!
He was pronounced dead at the scene.
Send in the next patient, please.
His family is waiting in the waiting room.
She's still on the fence about the surgery.
expressions.translation: 그녀는 아직 수술에 대해 확신이 없어요.

expressions.example: He suffered second-degree burns on his arm.
The X-ray confirmed a hairline fracture.
The player was pulled out with a concussion.
He's been in a coma for three weeks.
Miraculously, she woke up from her coma.
Good news, her vital signs are stable now.
expressions.translation: 좋은 소식이에요, 그녀의 활력 징후가 이제 안정적이에요.

expressions.example: He's still in surgery, it's been four hours.
She's resting in the recovery room now.
He's expected to get discharged tomorrow.
They had to readmit him after his fever returned.
expressions.translation: 열이 다시 나서 그를 재입원시켜야 했어요.

expressions.example: She's been in labor for eight hours.
The doctor delivered the baby safely.
They decided to perform an emergency C-section.
She asked for an epidural before the pain got worse.
expressions.translation: 그녀는 통증이 심해지기 전에 경막외 마취를 요청했어요.

expressions.example: The premature baby was placed in the NICU.
Her son spent two weeks in the NICU.
He was transferred to the ICU after the surgery.
We need to monitor her closely for the next 24 hours.
expressions.translation: 앞으로 24시간 동안 그녀를 면밀히 관찰해야 해요.

expressions.example: He has an underlying heart condition.
Does she have any family history of diabetes?
Heart disease runs in the family.
Dizziness is a common side effect of this drug.
He was rushed to the ER after an overdose.
expressions.translation: 그는 과다복용 후 응급실로 급히 이송됐어요.

expressions.example: She experienced severe withdrawal symptoms.
He's undergoing rehab after his injury.
expressions.translation: 그는 부상 이후 재활 치료를 받고 있어요.

expressions.example: She's been on the transplant list for a year.
He decided to become an organ donor.
Good news, a match was finally found.
expressions.translation: 좋은 소식이에요, 드디어 적합한 장기를 찾았어요.

expressions.example: His body began to reject the transplant.
expressions.translation: 그의 몸이 이식된 장기를 거부하기 시작했어요.

expressions.example: The injury is serious but not life-threatening.
expressions.translation: 그 부상은 심각하지만 생명을 위협하지는 않아요.

expressions.example: Hang in there, help is on the way.
The doctor said he's a fighter, he'll pull through.
expressions.translation: 의사는 그가 강한 사람이라 이겨낼 거라고 했어요.

expressions.example: Against all odds, she pulled through.
expressions.translation: 모든 예상을 뒤엎고 그녀는 위기를 이겨냈어요.

expressions.example: The little boy beat the odds and survived.
expressions.translation: 그 어린 소년은 역경을 이겨내고 살아남았어요.

expressions.example: After the check-up, he got a clean bill of health.
expressions.translation: 검진 후 그는 건강에 이상 없다는 판정을 받았어요.

expressions.example: They ran a battery of tests to find the cause.
expressions.translation: 원인을 찾기 위해 그들은 여러 검사를 진행했어요.
